The '''42-Aybock Ion''' was a luxury [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] model manufactured by [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]].

It was manufactured in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and endorsed by champion [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Lobar Aybock]], after whom it was also named.
